verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses entirely on Ryzen AI NPU/AI software (ONNX Runtime, LLM deployment, quantization, GAIA agents) and general CPU specs; no evidence documents the chip's media/video hardware encode-decode engines for AV1, HEVC, or ProRes-class formats.
